title: KCP events_wait request (DESIGN.md §11.3, §11.4, §11.6.1 read family)
description: Read: never mutates authoritative or user-visible state and never carries meta (closed shape — a read carrying meta, hence an idempotency key, fails; §11.2, R0 KENV-01). Bounded long-poll for new authorized events after an exact cursor; the §11.4 arg list verbatim (gap note KG28). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; connector service (only for its mapped resources) (assurance: current login or workload identity). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

filters.description: Delivery filters (§11.4 names the member with no grammar); open object that narrows, never widens, the authorized set (gap note KG28).

timeout_ms.description: Long-poll timeout in milliseconds (§11.4); DESIGN.md pins no ceiling (gap note KG28).

args.description: §11.4 events_wait args verbatim: { source, after_cursor, filters?, timeout_ms }.

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).
